description: WF-6 now reads notify_care_partner per domain via the checkins routine FKs, not from medications only. Food and health use their own routine name as the label; medication keeps the period label.
name: ElderWise WF-6 - Care Partner Notifications (All Domains)

parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS checkin_id, c.domain::text AS domain, c.status::text AS checkin_status, c.response_value, e.id AS elder_id, e.first_name AS elder_first_name, cp.id AS care_partner_id, cp.whatsapp_number AS cp_whatsapp, COALESCE(MIN(m.notify_care_partner::text), MIN(f.notify_care_partner::text), MIN(h.notify_care_partner::text), 'every_time') AS notify_mode, COALESCE(MIN(f.meal_name), MIN(h.name)) AS routine_name, to_char(c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE cp.timezone, 'FMHH12:MI am') AS scheduled_label_cp, to_char(COALESCE(c.responded_at, now()) AT TIME ZONE cp.timezone, 'FMHH12:MI AM, FMDD Mon') AS responded_label_cp, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone)) < 12 THEN 'Morning' WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone)) < 17 THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM (c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone)) < 21 THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Night' END AS period_label, CASE WHEN c.domain = 'medication' THEN (CASE c.response_value WHEN 'yes_all' THEN 'Taken' WHEN 'not_yet' THEN 'Not taken yet' WHEN 'some_of_them' THEN 'Partially taken' ELSE 'Recorded' END) WHEN c.domain = 'food' THEN (CASE c.response_value WHEN 'yes' THEN 'Had it' WHEN 'no' THEN 'Not yet' ELSE 'Recorded' END) WHEN c.domain = 'health' THEN (CASE c.response_value WHEN 'yes' THEN 'Feeling well' WHEN 'no' THEN 'Not feeling well' ELSE 'Recorded' END) ELSE 'Recorded' END AS status_label FROM checkins c JOIN elders e ON e.id = c.elder_id JOIN care_partners cp ON cp.id = e.care_partner_id LEFT JOIN medications m ON c.domain = 'medication' AND m.elder_id = e.id AND m.enabled AND m.active AND to_char(c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone, 'HH24:MI') = ANY(m.times) LEFT JOIN food_routines f ON f.id = c.food_routine_id LEFT JOIN health_routines h ON h.id = c.health_routine_id WHERE c.id = $1::uuid GROUP BY c.id, c.domain, c.status, c.response_value, c.scheduled_for, c.responded_at, e.id, e.first_name, e.timezone, cp.id, cp.whatsapp_number, cp.timezone
